release_notes: Orbitra 2.0.4: analytics reports get a Total row and sortable columns. The Trends report and the cohort summary end with a pinned Total — CR, landing CTR and ROI are recalculated from the sums, and unique clicks are counted once over the whole period (a visitor who came three days in a row is one unique, not three). Click any column header to sort, click again to reverse. New 'Show me on an example' button in the Trends and Cohort hints: the page switches to clearly labelled example data and walks you through grouping, metrics, the chart, sorting and the Total — your data is not touched. Fixes: CTR in Trends always read 100% (it is now the real landing CTR), toggling a metric now redraws the chart, percentages have their own axis, weekdays are named in your interface language.
